result.evidence: When duplicating a report in src/api/reports.ts (line 171), the code concatenates `${source.name} (copy)` and then calls `truncate(..., MAX_NAME_LENGTH)`. Because `MAX_NAME_LENGTH` is 120 and report names can already be up to 120 characters long, adding ` (copy)` exceeds the maximum length. Consequently, `truncate` cuts off the end and replaces the final characters with `...` (effectively replacing ` (copy)` or part of it with `...`), resulting in a name ending in `...` instead of `(copy)`. To fix this, the source name should be truncated first to leave enough room for ` (copy)`, or ` (copy)` should be appended after appropriately truncating the source name (e.g. truncating to `MAX_NAME_LENGTH - 7` characters before appending ` (copy)`).
